# Setup

## Open and build

Open `RevenueDashboard.xcodeproj`. Shared schemes: Xcode's auto-generated scheme. Validate with `<scheme>`.
There is no test plan; the scheme test action runs the unit tests.

```sh
xcodebuild -project RevenueDashboard.xcodeproj -scheme "<scheme>" \
  -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build
xcodebuild -project RevenueDashboard.xcodeproj -scheme "<scheme>" \
  -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=<installed iPhone simulator>' test
```

When several agent sessions are open on this project, only one builds or
tests at a time (CORE-VER-003).

## Local configuration

Git-ignored files that must exist locally (ask for them or copy from the example when there is one):

- `Config/Local.xcconfig`

Examples committed: `Config/Local.example.xcconfig`

Committed build configuration: `Config/Base.xcconfig`, `Config/Local.example.xcconfig`

## Lint

`.swiftlint.yml` inherits the handbook base (IOS-QUAL-001).

```sh
swiftlint lint --no-cache                  # whole project
swiftlint lint --no-cache path/to/File.swift   # files you changed
```
